node.statement: Fixed-level scope and rectangle input: fix n and X,Y,Z in B(C^n tensor H), set T=I_Mn tensor Phi, A=T(X), B=T(Y), C=T(Z), A1=T^2(X), B1=T^2(Y), C1=T^2(Z), and p=||X||||Y||||Z||. By node 1.2.1, ||T||<=1 and ||T^2(U)-T(U)||<=eta||U||. Using the Stinespring objects V_j,u_j,R_k defined in node 1.2.2, set W=V_1^* R_1(X^*)^* u_{3,0}(T(Y)) V_3 R_0(Z) and Q=T(T(AB)C)-T^2(AB)C1-T(A1B1C)+T(A1B1)C1. The exact expansion in node 1.2.2 gives W=T(Q) and ||W||<=3eta p.
